item.title: Blanche confirmed as attorney general despite Republican defections
item.description: Todd Blanche, Trump's pick to lead the DOJ, narrowly passed the Senate vote early Saturday after Sen. Bill Cassidy's last-minute support.

item.title: Dem senators back El-Sayed but avoid questions on progressive platform
